Watch From Anywhere

Your phone pushes its screen to your own relay server. Open that room here — no same-Wi-Fi needed.

Needs viewer-standalone.html next to this page and the Flask relay running (see relay-server/ in the app repo).

How It Works

RustDesk-style, minus the infrastructure bill

  1. Run server.py on your server behind HTTPS.
  2. In the app: Settings → Server relay → same URL, room and token.
  3. Start Screen Cast, then start the relay.
  4. Open the room here from any network.
